units.source_text: 我拿起笔给几个朋友分别写了寥寥数语的明信片或洋洋洒洒的长信。

en.t: I picked up my brush and wrote a few brief postcards or long, flowing letters to several friends.

units.source_text: 这些朋友有的留在了东京，有的回遥远的故乡去了。

en.t: Some of these friends had stayed in Tokyo, while others had gone back to distant hometowns.

units.source_text: 有人回了信，也有的没有回音。

en.t: Some replied to me, and some gave no answer at all.
Of course, I had not forgotten Sensei.

units.source_text: 关于自己回到故乡后的情况，我用细毛笔写了三页稿纸，寄给了先生。

en.t: I wrote three pages on manuscript paper with a fine brush about what had happened after I returned home, and sent them to Sensei.

units.source_text: 封信口时，我心里怀疑先生是否还在东京。

en.t: As I sealed the letter, I wondered whether Sensei was still in Tokyo.

units.source_text: 以往，先生和夫人一起出门的时候，会有一位五十岁左右的短发妇人来看家。

en.t: In the past, when Sensei went out with his wife, a short-haired woman of about fifty would come to watch the house.

units.source_text: 我曾问先生，她是什么人。

en.t: I once asked Sensei who she was.

units.source_text: 先生却反问我：“你看她像什么人呢？”

en.t: But Sensei asked me in return, "What kind of person does she look like to you?"

units.source_text: 我认为她是先生的亲戚。

en.t: I thought she was one of Sensei's relatives.

units.source_text: 可先生回答：“我可没有亲戚呀。”

en.t: But Sensei answered, "I have no relatives, you know."

units.source_text: 先生和故乡的亲戚一向没有书信往来的。

en.t: Sensei had never exchanged letters with the relatives in his hometown.

units.source_text: 原来那位看门的妇人，是和先生没有亲缘关系的夫人的亲戚。

en.t: It turned out that the woman who watched the house was a relative of his wife, not related to Sensei by blood.

units.source_text: 我给先生发信时，忽然想起了那个将窄腰带松松地在和服背后打个结的老妇。

en.t: When I mailed my letter to Sensei, I suddenly remembered the old woman who tied her narrow sash loosely at the back of her kimono.

units.source_text: 我猜想，这封信若是在先生夫妇去什么地方避暑之后寄到的话，

en.t: I imagined what would happen if this letter arrived after Sensei and his wife had gone somewhere for the summer.

units.source_text: 不知那位短发阿婆有没有把信转寄给先生的那份心计和热心。

en.t: I wondered whether that short-haired old woman would have the thoughtfulness and kindness to forward the letter to Sensei.

units.source_text: 不过，我这封信也没写什么特别要紧的事情，

en.t: Still, there was nothing especially important written in my letter.

units.source_text: 盼着先生给我回信，却始终没有收到回信。

en.t: I hoped Sensei would write back to me, but no reply ever came.
